effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] You may reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 level 6 card with the [Machine] trait among them to your hand. Trash the remaining cards.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon has the [Machine] trait, it gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
